name: IntelliDrive
tagline: Lets an LLM drive any hardware through a few exposed endpoints, shown with an RC car.
problem: Building autonomous devices needs custom vision models and domain-specific training, which blocks beginners.
solution: Exposes simple movement endpoints and camera input to an LLM through a tool protocol; you state a goal in plain language and the model drives the car toward it, on a real-time OS.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask the car to find something healthy to eat and watch it drive there.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Replaces custom computer-vision training with a general model and tools.

lessons: Expose a robot as tools and let the model plan; the demo shows agents in the physical world.
